readings.title: A Promise of Renewed Betrothal
readings.subtitle: The Valley of Achor as a Door of Hope
readings.text: [Hosea 2:14] <dq>“Therefore, see, <dn>I</dn> am alluring her, and shall lead her into the wilderness, and shall speak to her heart,</dq> [15] <dq>and give to her vineyards from there, and the Valley of Aḵor as a door of expectation. And there she shall respond as in the days of her youth, as in the day when she came up from the land of Mitsrayim.</dq> [16] <dq>“And it shall be, in that day,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“that you call <dn>Me</dn> ‘<dn>My</dn> Husband,’ and no longer call <dn>Me</dn> ‘<dn>My</dn> Ba‛al.’</dq> [17] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall remove the names of the Ba‛als from her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.</dq> [18] <dq>“And in that day <dn>I</dn> shall make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the birds of the heavens, and with the creeping creatures of the ground, when bow, and sword, and battle <dn>I</dn> break from the earth. And <dn>I</dn> shall make them lie down in safety.</dq> [19] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall take you as a bride unto <dn>Me</dn> forever, and take you as a bride unto <dn>Me</dn> in righteousness, and in right-ruling, and loving-commitment and compassion.</dq> [20] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall take you as a bride unto <dn>Me</dn> in trustworthiness, and you shall know <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [21] <dq>“And it shall be in that day that <dn>I</dn> answer,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“that <dn>I</dn> answer <dn>את</dn> the heavens, and they answer <dn>את</dn> the earth,</dq> [22] <dq>and the earth answer <dn>את</dn> the grain and the new wine and the oil, and they answer <dn>את</dn> Yizre‛ěl.</dq> [23] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall sow her for <dn>Myself</dn> in the earth, and <dn>I</dn> shall have compassion on her who had not obtained compassion. And <dn>I</dn> shall say to those who were not <dn>My</dn> people, ‘You are <dn>My</dn> people,’ while they say, ‘<dn>My</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>!’ ”</dq>

readings.title: Hosea Redeems His Adulterous Wife
readings.subtitle: A Symbol of Israel's Future Repentance
readings.text: [Hosea 3:1] Then <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to <dn>me</dn>, <dq>“Go again, love a woman loved by a friend, and an adulteress, according to the love of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> for the children of Yisra’ěl, though they are turning to other mighty ones and love their raisin cakes.”</dq> [2] So <dn>I</dn> bought her for <dn>myself</dn> for fifteen pieces of silver, and one and one-half ḥomers of barley. [3] And <dn>I</dn> said to her, “You are to remain with <dn>me</dn> many days, you are not to whore, nor become any man’s, and so <dn>I</dn> shall also be towards you.” [4] For many days the children of Yisra’ěl are to remain without sovereign and without prince, and without slaughtering, and without pillar, and without shoulder garment or house idols. [5] Afterward the children of Yisra’ěl shall return, and seek <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> their <dn>Elohim</dn>, and <dn>את</dn> Daviḏ their sovereign, and fear <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> goodness, in the latter days.

readings.title: A Lack of Knowledge and Truth
readings.subtitle: The Priests and People Judged
readings.text: [Hosea 4:1] Hear <dn>את</dn> the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, you children of Yisra’ěl, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has a case against the inhabitants of the land: <dq>“For there is no truth or loving-commitment or knowledge of <dn>Elohim</dn> in the land.</dq> [2] <dq>“Swearing, and lying, and murdering, and stealing, and committing adultery have increased. And bloodshed follows bloodshed.</dq> [3] <dq>“Therefore the land mourns, and everyone living there languishes, with the beasts of the field and the birds of the heavens. And the fish of the sea are taken away.</dq> [4] <dq>“However, let no one strive or reprove another, for your people are like those striving with a priest.</dq> [5] <dq>“And you shall stumble in the day, and the prophet shall also stumble with you in the night. And <dn>I</dn> shall make your mother perish.</dq> [6] <dq>“<dn>My</dn> people have perished for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected <dn>את</dn> knowledge, <dn>I</dn> reject you from being priest for <dn>Me</dn>. Since you have forgotten <dn>את</dn> the Torah of your <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>I</dn> also forget <dn>את</dn> your children.</dq> [7] <dq>“As they were increased, so they sinned against <dn>Me</dn>. <dn>My</dn> esteem they have changed into shame.</dq> [8] <dq>“They eat <dn>את</dn> the sin of <dn>My</dn> people, and lift up their desire to their crookedness.</dq> [9] <dq>“And it shall be: like people, like priest. And <dn>I</dn> shall punish them for their ways, and reward them for their deeds.</dq> [10] <dq>“And they shall eat but not be satisfied, they shall whore but not increase, for they have stopped obeying <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.”</dq>

readings.title: Idolatry and Spiritual Adultery
readings.subtitle: A Warning to Judah
readings.text: [Hosea 4:11] <dq>“Whoring, and wine, and new wine enslave <dn>את</dn> the heart.</dq> [12] <dq>“<dn>My</dn> people ask from their Wood, and their Staff declares to them. For a spirit of whorings has led them astray, and they went whoring from under their <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq> [13] <dq>“They slaughter on the mountaintops, and burn incense on the hills, under oak and poplars and terebinth, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters commit whoring, and your brides commit adultery.</dq> [14] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> would not punish your daughters when they commit whoring, nor your brides when they commit adultery, for the men themselves go aside with whores, and slaughter with cult prostitutes – a people that do not understand are thrust down!</dq> [15] <dq>“Though you are a whore, Yisra’ěl, let not Yehuḏah become guilty. Do not come up to Gilgal, nor go up to Běyth Aven, nor swear an oath, saying, ‘As <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> lives!’</dq> [16] <dq>“For Yisra’ěl is stubborn, like a stubborn calf. Would <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> now feed them like a lamb in a broad place?</dq> [17] <dq>“Ephrayim is joined to idols, let <dn>him</dn> alone.</dq> [18] <dq>“Their drink is sour, they have whored continually. Her rulers wildly loved shame.</dq> [19] <dq>“A wind has bound her up in its wings, and they are ashamed because of their slaughterings.”</dq>

readings.title: A Snare to the People
readings.subtitle: Israel's Pride Testifies Against Them
readings.text: [Hosea 5:1] <dq>“Hear this, O priests! And listen, O house of Yisra’ěl! Give ear, O house of the sovereign! For the judgment is for you, for you have been a snare to Mitspah and a net spread on Taḇor.</dq> [2] <dq>“And revolters have gone deep in slaying, and <dn>I</dn> reprove them all.</dq> [3] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> have known <dn>את</dn> Ephrayim, and Yisra’ěl has not been hidden from <dn>Me</dn>. For now, O Ephrayim, you have whored, Yisra’ěl is defiled.</dq> [4] <dq>“Their deeds do not allow them to turn back to their <dn>Elohim</dn>, for the spirit of whorings is among them, and they do not know <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [5] <dq>“And the Excellency of Yisra’ěl shall witness to his face, and Yisra’ěl and Ephrayim stumble in their crookedness. Yehuḏah shall also stumble with them.</dq> [6] <dq>“With their flocks and herds they go to seek <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, but do not find <dn>Him</dn> – <dn>He</dn> has withdrawn from them.</dq> [7] <dq>“They have acted treacherously against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, for they have brought forth strange children. Now a new moon shall devour them with their portions.”</dq>

readings.title: The Coming Invasion
readings.subtitle: God as a Lion to His People
readings.text: [Hosea 5:8] <dq>“Blow a shophar in Gib‛ah, the trumpet in Ramah! Shout, O Běyth Aven! Behind you, O Binyamin!</dq> [9] <dq>“Ephrayim is laid waste in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Yisra’ěl <dn>I</dn> shall make known <dn>את</dn> what is certain.</dq> [10] <dq>“The chiefs of Yehuḏah shall be like those who remove a border – on them <dn>I</dn> pour out <dn>my</dn> wrath like water.</dq> [11] <dq>“Ephrayim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, because <dn>he</dn> walked after the command when it pleased <dn>him</dn>.</dq> [12] <dq>“So <dn>I</dn> am to Ephrayim like a moth, and to the house of Yehuḏah like rottenness.</dq> [13] <dq>“When Ephrayim saw his sickness, and Yehuḏah saw his wound, then Ephrayim went to Ashshur and sent to Sovereign Yarěḇ. But <dn>he</dn> is unable to heal you, or to remove the wound from you.</dq> [14] <dq>“For <dn>I</dn> am like a lion to Ephrayim, and like a young lion to the house of Yehuḏah. <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> tear them and go, <dn>I</dn> take them away, and there is no one to deliver.</dq> [15] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall go, <dn>I</dn> shall return to <dn>My</dn> place, until they confess their guilt and seek <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> face, in their distress diligently search for <dn>Me</dn>, and say,”</dq>

readings.title: A Call to Return
readings.subtitle: Loving-Commitment, Not Sacrifice
readings.text: [Hosea 6:1] ‘Come, and let us turn back to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. For <dn>He</dn> has torn but <dn>He</dn> does heal <dn>us</dn>, <dn>He</dn> has stricken but <dn>He</dn> binds <dn>us</dn> up. [2] After two days <dn>He</dn> shall revive <dn>us</dn>, on the third day <dn>He</dn> shall raise <dn>us</dn> up, so that we live before <dn>Him</dn>. [3] So let us know, let us pursue to know <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. <dn>His</dn> going forth is as certain as the morning. And <dn>He</dn> comes to <dn>us</dn> like the rain, like the latter rain watering the earth.’ [4] <dq>“Ephrayim, what would <dn>I</dn> do with you? Yehuḏah, what would <dn>I</dn> do with you? For your loving-commitment is like a morning cloud, and like the early dew it goes away.</dq> [5] <dq>“Therefore <dn>I</dn> have hewn them by the prophets, <dn>I</dn> have killed them by the words of <dn>My</dn> mouth. And <dn>my</dn> right-rulings break forth as the light.</dq> [6] <dq>“For <dn>I</dn> delight in loving-commitment and not slaughtering, and in the knowledge of <dn>Elohim</dn> more than ascending offerings.”</dq>

readings.title: Covenant Transgressed
readings.subtitle: Wickedness in Gilead and Shechem
readings.text: [Hosea 6:7] <dq>“But like Aḏam they transgressed <dn>את</dn> the covenant. There they acted treacherously against <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [8] <dq>“Gil‛aḏ is a city of workers of wickedness – tracked up with blood.</dq> [9] <dq>“And as bands of robbers lie in wait for a man, so the company of priests murder on the way to Sheḵem, for they have done wickedness.</dq> [10] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> have seen <dn>את</dn> a horrible matter in the house of Yisra’ěl: the whoring of Ephrayim is there, Yisra’ěl is defiled.</dq> [11] <dq>“Also, a harvest is appointed for you, O Yehuḏah, when <dn>I</dn> turn back the captivity of <dn>My</dn> people.”</dq>

readings.title: The Uncovered Crookedness
readings.subtitle: A Heart Like a Burning Oven
readings.text: [Hosea 7:1] <dq>“Whenever <dn>I</dn> would heal Yisra’ěl, then the crookedness of Ephrayim is uncovered, and the evil deeds of Shomeron. For they have wrought falsehood, and a thief comes in, a band of robbers raids outside.</dq> [2] <dq>“And they do not say to their hearts that <dn>I</dn> remember <dn>את</dn> all their evil. Now their own deeds have surrounded them, they have been before <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [3] <dq>“With their evil they make a sovereign glad, and rulers with their lies.</dq> [4] <dq>“All of them are adulterers, as an oven heated by a baker, who ceases stirring the fire after kneading the dough, until it is leavened.</dq> [5] <dq>“In the day of our sovereign rulers became sick, inflamed with wine. <dn>He</dn> extended his hand with scoffers.</dq> [6] <dq>“For they have drawn near, their heart is like an oven. While they lie in wait all the night their baker sleeps. In the morning it burns like a flaming fire.</dq> [7] <dq>“All of them are as hot as an oven, and they consumed their rulers. All their sovereigns have fallen – not one among them calls on <dn>Me</dn>.”</dq>

readings.title: A Cake Unturned, A Simple Dove
readings.subtitle: Seeking Help from Egypt and Assyria
readings.text: [Hosea 7:8] <dq>“Ephrayim mixes <dn>himself</dn> among the peoples, Ephrayim has become a cake unturned.</dq> [9] <dq>“Strangers have devoured <dn>את</dn> <dn>his</dn> strength, but <dn>he</dn> does not know it. Grey hairs are also sprinkled on <dn>him</dn>, and <dn>he</dn> does not know it.</dq> [10] <dq>“And the Excellency of Yisra’ěl did witness to <dn>his</dn> face, but they did not return to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> their <dn>Elohim</dn>, nor did they seek <dn>Him</dn> for all this.</dq> [11] <dq>“And Ephrayim has become a simple dove without heart, they have called on Mitsrayim, they have gone to Ashshur.</dq> [12] <dq>“When they go <dn>I</dn> spread <dn>My</dn> net over them, <dn>I</dn> bring them down like the birds of the heavens, <dn>I</dn> chastise them as their congregation has heard.</dq> [13] <dq>“Woe to them, for they have strayed from <dn>Me</dn>! Destruction to them, because they have transgressed against <dn>Me</dn>! And <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> have ransomed them, yet they have spoken falsehoods against <dn>Me</dn>,</dq> [14] <dq>and did not cry out to <dn>Me</dn> with their heart when they wailed upon their beds. For grain and new wine they assemble themselves; they turn away from <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [15] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> instructed, <dn>I</dn> strengthened their arms, but they plot evil against <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [16] <dq>“They return but not above. They have been like a slack bow. Their rulers fall by the sword for the cursings of their tongue. This is their scorn in the land of Mitsrayim.”</dq>

readings.title: The Shophar of Warning
readings.subtitle: Idolatry and Illegitimate Kings
readings.text: [Hosea 8:1] <dq>“Put a shophar to your mouth, like an eagle against the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, because they have transgressed <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> covenant, and they have rebelled against <dn>My</dn> Torah.</dq> [2] <dq>“They cry out to <dn>Me</dn>, ‘<dn>My</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> – we, Yisra’ěl, know You!’</dq> [3] <dq>“Yisra’ěl has rejected <dn>את</dn> what is good, an enemy pursues <dn>him</dn>.</dq> [4] <dq>“They have made sovereigns, but not from <dn>Me</dn>. They have made rulers, but <dn>I</dn> have not known. From their silver and gold they made idols for themselves, so that they are cut off.</dq> [5] <dq>“O Shomeron, your calf has been cast off! <dn>My</dn> wrath has burned against them. How long shall they be incapable of innocence?</dq> [6] <dq>“For from Yisra’ěl is even this: a workman made it, and it is not <dn>Elohim</dn>! For the calf of Shomeron is splinters!</dq> [7] <dq>“For they sow <dn>את</dn> the wind, and reap <dn>את</dn> the whirlwind. The stalk has no bud, it yields no grain. If it does yield, strangers swallow it up.”</dq>

readings.title: Swallowed by the Nations
readings.subtitle: Forgotten Maker, Forgotten Torah
readings.text: [Hosea 8:8] <dq>“Yisra’ěl has been swallowed up. They have now become among the nations as a vessel in which is no pleasure.</dq> [9] <dq>“For they themselves have gone up to Ashshur. A wild donkey alone by itself is Ephrayim, they have hired lovers.</dq> [10] <dq>“Also, although they sold themselves among the nations, this time <dn>I</dn> shall gather them, when they have suffered for a while from the burden of a sovereign, of rulers.</dq> [11] <dq>“Since Ephrayim has made many slaughter-places for sin, they have been slaughter-places for sinning to <dn>him</dn>.</dq> [12] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> have written for <dn>him</dn> numerous matters of <dn>My</dn> Torah – they were regarded as strange.</dq> [13] <dq>“As for <dn>My</dn> slaughterings: they slaughter flesh and they eat. <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall not accept them. Now does <dn>He</dn> remember their crookedness and punish their sins. Let them return to Mitsrayim!</dq> [14] <dq>“For Yisra’ěl has forgotten <dn>את</dn> <dn>his</dn> Maker, and has built palaces. And Yehuḏah has increased walled cities. But <dn>I</dn> shall send fire upon <dn>his</dn> cities, and it shall devour <dn>his</dn> strongholds.”</dq>
